title: Systemic Biases in Sign Language AI Research: A Deaf-Led Call to Reevaluate Research Agendas
reasoning: The paper is a systematic review and position paper critiquing systemic biases such as audism and ableism in the field of sign language AI. While it discusses the ethics of research practice and stakeholder inclusion, it does not involve evaluating or benchmarking models for religion, morals, or ethics.
